safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting safety-net advice for red-flag deterioration (e.g., worsening shortness of breath, chest pain, persistent/high fever) can delay urgent reassessment in a patient already reporting breathlessness and systemic symptoms, potentially missing pneumonia, sepsis, PE, or cardiac causes. This delay could worsen outcomes and functional status by postponing time-sensitive evaluation and treatment.
